location_name: Swallow Reef, Commodore Reef, Royal Charlotte Reef and another claimed reef
summary: Under 'Operasi Tugu' (Op Tugu), launched on 31 January 1980 to carry out the Cabinet's June 1979 order for permanent sovereignty monuments, Royal Engineer Regiment teams carried by the Navy laid monument foundations on four Malaysian-claimed Spratly features, including Swallow Reef, during Phase I (2-19 April 1980).
